statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been halted since Friday at 21:00Z and the three slots up to the scheduled 22:00Z reopen contain no tradable Nasdaq-100 interval at all; the twenty-one slots from the reopen onward carry conditional Tail readings between 10 and 18, every one of them below the block threshold. Stress is 43, moderate, and one point above the previous hour as the reopen draws closer with an unpriced queue: an Iranian threat to Gulf and Hormuz oil flows, a now time-confirmed US Treasury sanctions news conference at 18:00Z on Monday, Brent at 94.39 dollars after a 6.6% weekly gain, and a long end that reached its highest 30-year yield since 2007 last week. None of it can be priced until the venue reopens. Confidence is 84, high, on index levels verified at the index owner, H.15 yields, settled oil and volatility prints and a verified calendar, held below very-high only because no live Nasdaq-100 price path exists in a weekend halt.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: the Nasdaq-100 traded a 29,142.44 to 29,405.12 range on Friday and settled at 29,308.86, up 0.33% on the day but 2% lower on the week, while the VIX finished at 14.89 after a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced, so no persistent directional efficiency is on record and nothing in the current evidence set establishes one. The material change this hour is that the US Treasury sanctions news conference now carries a verified 18:00Z Monday slot, which places a dated high-impact catalyst in the final forecast hour rather than leaving it undated. Tail-relevant structure cannot be observed again until the 22:00Z reopen, so the narrow evidence-based danger window covers 22:00Z to 02:00Z, when the weekend information set is repriced into thin liquidity. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this assessment.
headline: Closed-venue assessment three hours before the reopen: Tail holds the floor of 4 through the remaining shut hours, then carries conditional readings between 10 and 18 from the 22:00Z Sunday reopen through Monday's US session, with the newly time-confirmed 18:00Z Treasury sanctions news conference landing in the final forecast slot.
body: CME Globex equity index futures stopped trading for the week on Friday at 21:00Z and are scheduled to reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z. The twenty-four slots published here run from 2026-08-23T19:00:00Z to 2026-08-24T18:00:00Z, so three closed hours are followed by the reopen slot and twenty tradable hours, and Monday's 12:30Z Chicago Fed release, the 13:30Z US cash open, the 15:30Z bill auctions and the 18:00Z Treasury sanctions news conference all fall inside the window. The Nasdaq-100 settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 95.69 points or 0.33%, having traded a 29,142.44 to 29,405.12 range; the level, high, low and net change are confirmed directly at the index owner. Both extremes were retraced, which is the opposite of the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension structure that would justify a raised Tail. On the week the Nasdaq fell about 2% as long-end yields pressured growth and semiconductors, with the 30-year reaching its highest level since 2007 and the 10-year at 4.69% on the 20 August H.15 observation. Brent settled at 94.39 dollars and WTI at 87.06, weekly gains of 6.6% and 5.7%, while gold added about 5% on the week to 4,603.30 dollars, a cross-asset pattern consistent with geopolitical and fiscal risk premia rather than with an equity liquidation. The VIX at 14.89 does not corroborate index stress. Delayed shared cross-asset context for the last session shows Nasdaq futures firmer, the VIX future lower, gold sharply higher, Treasury futures lower across the curve, five of eight megacaps positive with a wide dispersion, and semiconductors mildly negative; it is used only as confirmation and never as live price-path evidence. The single new verified item this hour is the confirmed 2 p.m. Eastern Monday timing of the US Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions, which is a scheduled catalyst rather than a reported outcome and is therefore carried in the event calendar and in the final forecast slot as a Stress input. Tail stays at 4 for the shut hours because no Nasdaq-100 price path can form inside them.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is partial: 19 hourly assessments are available and 5 clock-hours have no published assessment and are marked unavailable (21:00Z on 22 August, then 07:00Z, 10:00Z, 11:00Z and 12:00Z on 23 August). Across every available hour Tail held 4 and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON, so no hour approached the block threshold and the dominant mode remained normal throughout. Stress traced a shut-weekend arc, easing from 40 at the start of the window to a low of 34 in the European morning before turning higher through the afternoon to 42 in the most recent published hour as the reopen drew closer. Confidence eased from 86 to 84 as the last observed session receded further into the past.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. The next two slots describe the same closed market, so Tail holds 4 and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON throughout them, while Stress climbs from 43 to 45 into the reopen. The final twenty-one slots are tradable. The 22:00Z scheduled reopen and the first full hour after it carry a conditional Tail of 15 on the untested assumption that a weekend gap could extend before retracing; an orderly two-way reopen would invalidate that. Conditional Tail then decays to 10 through the quiet Asian hours, where two-way trade has historically been most reliable, before rebuilding through the European session to 14 into the 12:30Z Chicago Fed release, 16 at the 13:30Z US cash open and 17 in the first full cash hour, easing to 14 across the midday lull and reaching a window maximum of 18 in the 18:00Z slot that contains the scheduled US Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions. Every one of the twenty-four published slots stays below the block threshold, so the mapped policy state is EA_ON across the whole window. None of the post-reopen structure is observed; each figure is a conditional reading that a genuine two-way path would reduce and that shallow pullbacks with repeated extension would raise.
